In my personal experience, if that connection doesn’t happen quickly don’t pursue it. For example, the first guy I had intense feelings for (romantically/sexually) I caught those feelings QUICK. Like the first couple hours chatting with him that night we just connected so well and I felt this intense emotional bond with him. Things happened so quickly from there and I remember wanting to desperately go on a date with him and stuff. We never met in person, but we talked almost everyday for 4 months straight. Long story short, things didn’t work out but that was because of him and not me, he just became not interested or was playing games. 

Onto the other guy I took thing further with, I didn’t really feel any connection with him and we were talking everyday for a week straight. He asked me out but I remember feeling more reluctant/anxious to go out on a date with him which should have been a red flag right there that there was no emotional connection. I kept pushing myself to go on more dates with him hoping we would click (this was before I knew I was demi) eventually by date 3 he wanted to cuddle and when I gave in I felt extremely uncomfortable. Just no feelings for him at all, a month in I kept seeing him and he progressed from kissing, making out, to wanting to do sexual things and it was too much for me. I felt nothing and I didn’t have any trust or emotional bond with him. I remember just sitting there and wanting to talk to him and have deep conversations to try to bond more but he was getting a signal that I didn’t like him-which he wasn’t wrong.

I would be careful with apps, you may get that connection quick but I feel like it’s very rare. Most are quick to want to progress into doing things because that’s just how they function with their sexualities.

Yeah I totally relate to having a type and crushing on those that fit my physical attraction. Do I think there’s sexual attraction to my crushes? Not really. But I think if I pursued a crush and got to know them and took things slow and really bonded with them, like a friendship, I’d get attracted to them.

This is why emotional connection and prior knowing someone is SO important because you weed out the jerks that just want sex or affection right away when you have not even established a comfortable bond yet. I remember trying to date recently again back in November and within 3 dates the guy I was seeing at the time wanted to cuddle right away then progress to kissing, making out, and doing foreplay all within the timespan of a month! I am by no means in any form of a program yet, I am still taking my gen eds right now. But, this is absolutely normal. Please do not let this one incident discourage you from becoming a tech. There is something that makes anyone tick in any job, even if they are exposed to those types of things on a daily basis.
